privacy.accountBody: Clerk manages your sign-in details. The mobile app stores your Clerk account ID, email, username, name and profile image URL in its own database. It does not store your password.
privacy.sharedBody: Your login and profile are shared with the LINK website. Mobile activity data is kept separately. This version does not record audio or collect lesson results.
privacy.deleteBody: Deleting your account removes your shared Clerk identity and starts data removal in both apps. The mobile database keeps only an opaque account ID and deletion time so delayed updates cannot restore deleted information. Technical request counters expire automatically.
privacy.contactHint: Use Contact us in Account to ask the LINK team about your data.
